policy: Only the 53 named applicability/profile disagreements, indeterminate observations and assessment limitations are nonblocking dispositions. Preserve original metadata, expectations, input bytes and actual outcomes. None counts as an original or conformance pass. Import/missing-component/annotation URI defects and optional-mapping candidates are outside this scope.
history_note: Repository commit identifiers were removed when history was squashed. Artifact paths containing pre-squash are historical labels, not current filesystem locations. Input checksums and recorded outcomes are unchanged.

categories.rationale: These originals use XSD1.1-only notQName/notNamespace/defined-name wildcard features. Metadata lacks a version gate, so the faithful metadata importer classified them applicable. Product unknown-attribute rejection is consistent with the frozen1.0 profile.

Metadata explicitly includes1.0 and1.1. vc001/vc002/vc014/vc024 depend on XSD1.1 conditional-inclusion attributes minVersion/maxVersion/typeAvailable/typeUnavailable/facetAvailable to remove otherwise incompatible constructs. The raw frozen SecondEdition path does not perform that preprocessing.

Each original expected validity is indeterminate, so no binary valid/invalid comparison is available. Eleven actual records have passed:null; particlesZ026.v is schema-unavailable and schZ012_a is incomplete-refusal, both recorded passed:false. Completion/refusal is distinct from an original validity oracle.

mgO020/mgP041/mgP050 contain nonempty redefine referring to absent foo. Unlike optional composition, replacement components require successful resolution. Resource refusal also prevents reaching additional invalid all-group occurrence constraints.

Four IBM originals involve redefine cycles, not merely ordinary includes; their original oracle and schZ006 are INVALID, but current terminal is incomplete ResourceCycle refusal. schU1 expects VALID while metadata remains disputed-test and W3C4135 unresolved. Existing approvals for schU3/U4/U5 do not cover these six.

These instance-only originals hint invalid schemas. test73456.xsd places attribute inside sequence; test84002_a/b.xsd contain forbidden prefixed namespace undeclarations; addB191a.xsd references no-namespace b without its own import. Current schema-unavailable does not assess the original instance predicate.

stE110.xsd has union cycle st to st2 to st. The original schema expects VALID despite the1.0 circular-union prohibition and queried upstream issue4957. Product rejects the schema; its dependent instance is unassessed.

Metadata describes particlesZ001 restriction as invalid in1.0 and valid in1.1, but schema VALID is not version-gated. The1.0 restriction mapping fails its occurrence comparison; dependent1.0 instance INVALID cannot be assessed after compile failure.

addB163.v repeats the same foo hint after a prior physical foo namespace use. Original expects VALID. Actual remains instance-hint-ordering-limitation; its recorded supplementary engine assessment is instance-invalid with XSD.HintOrder. The verified seven-ID guard does not cover this case.
